name: 9520-multiimage-12b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 64 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_image` + `synthetic_text` zipped into one request: five 1024x1024 jpeg images (quality 85, gradient content, seeds 42-46) and one 32-token question, answered in exactly 64 tokens (min = max, temperature 0.0). Single turn, five images on every request, different images on every request. Each image expands to 4160 placeholder tokens, so the engine reports roughly 20870 prompt tokens per request rather than 32.
purpose: A visual inspection assistant answering short questions on five high-resolution photos per request, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# The interpreter that runs this engine and the hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml, which is
# this machine's and is NOT portable.

model: nm-testing/pixtral-12b-FP8-dynamic
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Required at this image count: start-up memory profiling does not complete at bfloat16 on an
# 80 GB card. See configs/note.md.
dtype: float16

max-model-len: 30000
max-num-seqs: 8

# Must match the number of images configs/scenario.json sends. Keep it on ONE line: the
# reader takes this file line by line and skips indented ones, so a block mapping drops the
# key and the engine starts without it.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 5}

# 0.90 as declared. Lowering it does not buy start-up headroom here -- it sizes the KV pool
# during the profiling forward and does not bound what that forward allocates.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
